_comment: Who holds each Earn operational role, per network: read by deploy/27_wire_Earn.ts (deploy/earnWiring.ts, grantEarnRoles). Every list is null until the owner fills it: the script refuses to grant anything while any is null or short of its minimum (deploy/earnWiring.ts, EARN_ROLE_MINIMUMS). Use [] only where none is the answer (EXCLUDED_HOLDER_ROLE, when Clear has no insiders holding bonds). On the pool: two DEPLOYER_ROLE signers for each Deployment; two VALUATION_ROLE signers, who must not be Deployment signers (PHASE-2F-YIELD-POOL.md section 9); SUSPENSION_ROLE, CCO_ROLE and TREASURER_ROLE for Suspensions and legal holds, two different people, one of them the CCO or the treasurer (decision 34). On EarnControls, each granted with the Lending Board resolution (EARN_RESOLUTION): ATTESTER_ROLE (the app's attestation key, plus the household attesters), and two each of PAUSE_ROLE, SUCCESSOR_ROLE, ELIGIBILITY_ROLE, LADDER_ROLE, FUNDING_ROLE and WIND_DOWN_ROLE; ROLL_NOTICE_ROLE (Clear Lending's notice key); EXCLUDED_HOLDER_ROLE (Clear Lending's certified insiders, decision 30). BOND_ROLE is the collection's, granted by deploy 23. revokeBorrowers: addresses whose old LendingPool BORROWER_ROLE is revoked (decision 17); the card settler is the one ops-roles.map.json records.
